summary: Blinko is a self-hosted note-taking application that incorporates artificial intelligence features. It allows you to record and organise personal notes within your own infrastructure using a containerised deployment model.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a private, self-hosted alternative to mainstream note apps who want to experiment with integrated AI functionality.
watchOut: As an AGPL-3.0 licensed tool with a specific feature set, it may overlap heavily with more mature open-source note-taking alternatives, and its reliance on AI features could introduce external API dependencies or higher resource demands.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
